title: Addressing Moral Uncertainty using Large Language Models for Ethical Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM to act as a general 'moral agent' without providing explicit moral frameworks (moral clusters), and comparing its decision-making behavior in simulated environments (e.g., 'Finding Milk' and 'Driving and Rescuing') against behaviors guided by specific ethical theories to reveal the model's inherent moral alignment.
